dedupe_keys.name: caiso integrated resource planning stochastic plexos production cost models california iso

description: The California ISO publishes the production cost simulation models it builds for the California Public Utilities Commission integrated resource planning proceeding (CPUC Docket R.20-05-003), as PLEXOS databases that others can rerun. Coverage: the CAISO system and its modelled neighbours; three model sets are listed on the library page: stochastic and deterministic models with the CEC 2019 IEPR load forecast; stochastic models set up for 2023 to 2026 and 2032 (the file list also holds a 2022 case) built on the CPUC 2019-20 preferred system portfolio (Decision 22-02-004, the 38 MMT portfolio) with the CEC 2021 IEPR hourly load forecast and run with PLEXOS v8.3R9, whose results went to the California Energy Commission in a letter of 2 February 2023; and a 2024 stochastic model on the CPUC 2022-23 preferred system portfolio (Decision 24-02-047, 25 MMT) with the CEC 2023 IEPR forecast, used for the 2024 Summer Loads and Resources Assessment. Format and access: zipped PLEXOS model files of about 240 MB each on the CAISO library pages (the 2021-forecast set was reposted on 11 June 2025); free to download. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the models need a PLEXOS licence to run; model contents, network detail and assumptions beyond the notices were not read; CAISO's transmission planning production cost models are separate postings. Simulation uses: stochastic production cost simulation for resource adequacy, capacity planning and optimisation studies of the California grid. Related records: the models run in PLEXOS (platform-plexos-energy-market-simulation), can be edited with plexos-coad (model-plexos-coad), and CAISO market data come from OASIS (data-caiso-oasis).
